title: Count with a for loop
summary: Lua: Count with a for loop. Count up to 4.
introduction: A numeric for loop includes both its start and end values. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Count with a for loop with Lua

blocks.text: Install Lua 5.3 or 5.4. Save each example as lesson.lua and run lua lesson.lua.
The counted loop includes 3. It prints one number on each pass.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use a comma between start and end, not a range operator.
